\parbox{\linewidth}{\scriptsize Gains are P(feature $|$ passed stage)/P(feature $|$ entered stage), year-standardised over 2024-26; total = accepted/all; 95\% CIs from a paper bootstrap stratified by year (B = 2000). Audit: pre-decision arXiv v1 vs stored title (abstract for F24 and em dash), accepted minus rejected net flips (pseudo-flip Wald 95\% CI); a feature is auditable with $>$= 10 v1-present titles in both arms. D$^{*}$: net-flip DiD that would bring the decision gain to 1; the gain is identified only if D$^{*}$ lies outside the DiD CI. The abstract em dash cannot be audited (arXiv renders TeX dashes). --- = not audited (union, density or typography-inclusive measures).}
